invariants.expression: name == null ? result == -1 : result == x + name.length()
invariants.rationale: Direct correspondence between inputs and result as per the branching in the method.
If name is not null, result = x + name.length() >= x.
If name is null, the method always returns -1.
For all executions, the trivial inner path is always possible (syntactically true for integer domain).
Both possible results are -1 or greater (because name.length() >= 0 and x is integer).
